result.requirement: The system shall assign the authority to approve or reject a Dispute Ticket to a specific actor based on the ticket's origin, severity, and the involved partners.
result.business_need: The business needs a clear, automated assignment of dispute resolution authority to ensure fair, timely, and legally compliant handling of customer claims.
functional_behaviour: The system shall automatically assign the Platform Operator as the approver for disputes involving financial adjustments or regulatory violations.
The system shall automatically assign the Store Partner as the approver for disputes related to missing items or product quality originating from their inventory.
The system shall automatically assign the Delivery Partner as the approver for disputes related to delivery proof or late arrival caused by their performance.
The system shall prevent an actor from approving a Dispute Ticket where they are listed as the accused party in the incident.
The system shall escalate the Dispute Ticket to a Fulfillment Supervisor if the assigned actor does not respond within the defined timeframe.
The system shall record the assigned approver and their decision timestamp on the Dispute Ticket for audit purposes.
related_information_requirements: The nature of the dispute issue (e.g., missing item, damage, late delivery)
The origin of the order (Store Partner or Delivery Partner)
The severity level of the dispute
The current resolution status of the ticket
The identity of the accused party in the dispute
business_rules: An actor cannot approve a Dispute Ticket where they are the accused party.
Disputes involving financial refunds must be approved by the Platform Operator.
Disputes regarding product quality must be approved by the Store Partner.
Disputes regarding delivery performance must be approved by the Delivery Partner.
Unresolved Dispute Tickets must be escalated to a Fulfillment Supervisor after the initial assignment deadline.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Dispute Ticket is created for a missing item originating from a Store Partner
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the ticket for authority assignment
acceptance_criteria.then: The Store Partner is assigned as the approver and the Platform Operator is excluded.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Dispute Ticket is created for a damaged package where the Delivery Partner is the accused party
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the ticket for authority assignment
acceptance_criteria.then: The Delivery Partner is excluded from approval and the Platform Operator is assigned as the approver.
